sports.palette_bias: energetic contrast with clean subject separation
extra_rules: sport equipment must be anatomically and logically correct
prefer decisive action over posed portrait

food.palette_bias: appetising warmth with premium highlight contrast

extra_rules: show journey or discovery, not just scenery

music.palette_bias: emotional stage or intimate ambient lighting
extra_rules: instrument or performance act must be obvious

gaming.palette_bias: warm social atmosphere with readable game surface
extra_rules: interaction between people matters as much as game objects
show process, tools, and hands where useful

technology.palette_bias: cool modern base with controlled warm human accents

extra_rules: medium or experience must be unmistakable

wellness.palette_bias: soft restrained tones with clean light

extra_rules: keep hobby identity stronger than scenery
